description: This file defines a speech processing pipeline using AVFoundation and Speech frameworks. It includes structures, enums, and an actor for managing live microphone input, speech analysis, and transcription, with methods to start and stop the pipeline.

classes.name: SpeechSegment
classes.description: A data structure representing a segment of transcribed speech, including the text and whether it is final.

classes.name: SpeechPipelineError
classes.description: An enumeration of possible errors occurring within the speech pipeline, such as authorization denial or unavailable modules.

classes.name: SpeechPipeline
classes.description: An actor managing the live speech recognition pipeline, including starting, stopping, and handling audio buffers.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the speech recognition pipeline with specified locale and etiquette options, returning an asynchronous stream of speech segments.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the speech recognition pipeline, cancels ongoing tasks, and finalizes analysis.

methods.name: handleBuffer
methods.description: Converts and processes incoming audio buffers for analysis.

methods.name: requestAuthorizationIfNeeded
methods.description: Requests speech recognition authorization if not already determined.
